'''Sennoa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the freelance [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Tertra Essa]] was arrested by authorities on Sennoa.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Independent Contractor}}</ref>
